measurement_notes: Source and executable stability are asserted within each measurement run.
The follow-up pipeline tool adds --only and hashes all three changed crates; measurement logic and binaries are unchanged.
No campaign build overlapped production measurements; process inventories before and after were empty. Background desktop activity was not fully controlled.
Measurements precede the final version-only workspace/lockfile bump. Production Rust sources are unchanged by that bump.
Raw complete DTOs remain in target/lua-boundaries/pipeline-pairs and capture-confirmation; exact Debug snapshots were compared by the runner.
No interactive behavior was migrated and no new VM-free gameplay coverage is claimed.
